units.source_text: 不被人理解已经成为我惟一的自豪。

en.t: Not being understood by others had already become my only pride.

units.source_text: 所以，那种欲使外界理解我的表现的冲动也不能光顾于我。

en.t: Therefore, the urge to express myself so that the outside world would understand me never visited me either.

units.source_text: 我觉得命运不赋予我任何能醒人耳目的东西。

en.t: I felt that fate had granted me nothing that could make people sit up and take notice.
My loneliness swelled all the more.
It was just like a pig.
